clauses.1.1: The next GPU goes to the eligible member with the most credits (savings × days held). Eligible means savings of at least 20% of the asset price. If underwriting fails, the turn passes to the next member.
clauses.1.2: On their turn, a member's savings convert into their deposit and initial equity at the locked price.
clauses.1.3: Credits reset to zero when a member takes their turn.
clauses.2.1: The deposit (converted savings) must be at least 20% of the asset price.
clauses.2.2: The asset price must not exceed £10,000.
clauses.2.3: The supplier must be on the allowlist.
clauses.2.4: Projected monthly inference revenue must be at least 125% of the initial monthly rent (ICR).
clauses.2.5: The pool must hold enough cash to pay the supplier in full.
clauses.3.1: Rent is 5% of the locked asset price per month, multiplied by the pool's ownership share.
clauses.3.2: Each month, metered inference revenue is compared with rent. An ICR below 125% is flagged.
clauses.3.3: Rent is distributed to members pro rata to their savings, excluding the lessee of that asset.
clauses.4.1: Enforcement starts only after the final failed payment attempt.
clauses.4.2: A member may take at most one payment holiday per 12 months, and none after a broken promise.
clauses.4.3: Unpaid rent is settled by transferring the member's equity to the pool at the locked price, rounded down in the member's favour.
clauses.4.4: When the member's equity reaches zero, the lease ends, access is revoked and the GPU is re-leased.
clauses.4.5: Non-recourse: arrears beyond the member's equity are written off. Savings are never touched.
clauses.5.1: Title transfers to the member at 100% equity with zero arrears.
clauses.5.2: Buybacks are voluntary, at the locked price, in multiples of £10, at least £500 (or the remaining balance), with no arrears outstanding.
